title: Pure SPYRAL
summary: Pure SPYRAL with generic Rank 4s, Links, and staples. The strategy revolves around SPYRAL Super Agent and calling the card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap) on top of the opponent's Deck, which SPYRAL GEAR - Drone and SPYRAL Double Agent reveal or stack in advance.

summary.title: Starters
points: SPYRAL Resort searches any SPYRAL monster once per turn and prevents the opponent from targeting your other SPYRAL cards with card effects.

SPYRAL Quik-Fix searches any SPYRAL GEAR card on Normal or Special Summon, and discards a card to revive itself from the GY while you control SPYRAL Super Agent (banishing itself when it leaves the field unless detached as Xyz Material).

SPYRAL Super Agent declares a card type to reveal the top card of the opponent's Deck and Special Summon itself from the hand on a match, then pops an opposing Spell/Trap when summoned by a SPYRAL effect.

summary.title: Opening: SPYRAL Resort + Quik-Fix
steps: Activate SPYRAL Resort to search SPYRAL Super Agent, then Normal Summon SPYRAL Quik-Fix to search SPYRAL GEAR - Drone (or SPYRAL GEAR - Big Red).
Special Summon Super Agent by calling the opponent's top card (or revive it with Big Red after discarding it for Quik-Fix), then Link Summon SPYRAL Double Helix.
Use Double Helix to call the opponent's top card and Special Summon another SPYRAL from your Deck or GY, while reviving Quik-Fix to search SPYRAL GEAR - Last Resort and SPYRAL GEAR - Utility Wire.

summary.title: Top-Deck Espionage
summary.text: SPYRAL GEAR - Drone looks at the top three cards of the opponent's Deck on summon and rearranges them in any order. SPYRAL Double Agent Special Summons itself to the opponent's field from your hand or GY while you have a SPYRAL in your GY, reveals the top card of both Decks permanently, and lets SPYRAL Super Agent attack directly. Together they guarantee every top-deck call for Super Agent, SPYRAL Tough, SPYGAL Misty, and Double Helix.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: SPYRAL Sleeper banishes 3 SPYRAL cards from your GY to Special Summon itself and destroys up to 2 opposing cards as a Quick Effect by targeting 1 SPYRAL card you control; equipping it with SPYRAL GEAR - Last Resort makes Sleeper untargetable and immune to its own self-destruction.
SPYRAL Double Helix counts as SPYRAL Super Agent on the field and in the GY, enabling Quik-Fix revivals and pulling SPYRAL monsters from the Deck or GY.
Tri-Gate Wizard gains banish removal and an omni-negate when co-linked with your SPYRAL and generic Link Monsters.

summary.title: Spells, Traps & Left out
points: SPYRAL GEAR - Big Red revives a SPYRAL and protects it from battle destruction, while SPYRAL GEAR - Utility Wire spins an opposing face-up card to the top of their Deck while you control Super Agent.
SPYRAL MISSION - Assault and SPYRAL MISSION - Rescue draw cards, recover SPYRAL monsters, and banish themselves from the GY to Special Summon SPYRAL monsters from the hand or GY.
Left out: SPYRAL Master Plan is Forbidden in the TCG.
